server_definitions is the only handler that computes a hash: sha512Half over the serialised definitions JSON.
The sha512Half call in ServerInfo.cpp computes the definitions hash served by server_definitions; server_info itself returns server state and emits no hash.

sign calls transactionSign, which signs the transaction with the supplied secret key (and re-verifies the signature at construct time via checkValidity). Gated on canSign() (Config.h:365-367) for non-ADMIN callers.
sign_for calls transactionSignFor, which signs for a multi-signing account with the supplied secret key. Gated on canSign() for non-ADMIN callers.
simulate rejects signed input and dry-runs via TxQ::apply; any signature verification is indirect, inside the apply pipeline, not in the handler.
No signing, key-exchange or hashing operation in the handler implementation; registration site only.
submit has two paths: with tx_blob it verifies the submitted signatures (STTx::checkSign); without it, it signs like sign — inline signing deprecated (Submit.cpp:67-71) and gated on canSign().
submit_multisigned accepts no secret key; it assembles a pre-signed multi-signed blob and verifies the signatures via transactionConstructImpl/checkValidity.
